dedupe_keys.name: bc municipal water survey 2016 water use pricing and metering of british columbia local governments

description: The BC Municipal Water Survey 2016 gives an overview of local water use, water pricing and metering coverage across British Columbia, collected by contacting local governments in the summer and autumn of 2015. It was designed to continue the Municipal Water and Wastewater Survey that Environment Canada previously ran and then discontinued. The Water Planning Lab at the University of British Columbia's School of Community and Regional Planning produced it and published two tables, the survey answers and the rate structures, as a free download from Borealis (the Canadian Dataverse) under CC0 (released February 2019). Coverage is the local governments of one province that answered in 2015. Caveats: it is a one-off survey with self-reported answers and is now ten years old. Simulation uses: household demand and price response parameters for capacity planning and agent-based water demand models. Related record: Statistics Canada's Canadian Core Public Infrastructure Survey (data-statcan-canada-core-public-infrastructure-survey).
